The PKGBUILD contains only variable assignments and function definitions with no top-level code execution during sourcing. The build() function only runs the downloaded binary to generate shell completions (normal upstream behavior). The update.sh script is a standard AUR maintainer helper that automates checking for new releases, downloading assets, verifying checksums, and updating PKGBUILD/.SRCINFO - all network operations target the official GitHub repository. The base64-encoded text in a PKGBUILD comment is inert and not executed. All files follow standard AUR packaging conventions with no injection patterns.

learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from substantive security concerns - an inconclusive verdict due to API error should not block a safe verdict when other models successfully reviewed the same files
